description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) API operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh: 要查询的防护对象名称。您可以设置该参数，精确查询已接入 WAF 的防护对象。
description.en: The name of the protected object to query. You can set this parameter to precisely query a protected object that has been added to WAF.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-4xl0000i60i --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --resource example.aliyundoc.com-waf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
